title.narrative: In 2025, UNICEF worked with national and local authorities to strengthen social inclusion for vulnerable refugee children and families. Efforts included piloting Spilno Centres, services in collective accommodation, additional social workers, training for integration centres and professionals supporting Roma refugees from Ukraine. 166,703 children, including 26,779 Ukrainians, received individualized support.
